justification: House page and paid report showed our internal row-type tags (NO FIGURE:, FSR-CONTROLLED: ...) and a bare 'No set number' on 40 served rows across the 10 pilot councils. Standard: display text only, three render sites and one report line, no query change.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls served rows: 67 with no number (nofig_db.json), condition prefixes measured: NO FIGURE 27, FSR-CONTROLLED 9, DEFERS-TO-ADG 6, CHARACTER-BASED 2, ALTERNATIVE-METRIC 1, QUALITATIVE 1
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: publicCondition stripped only 'NOT yet stored' notes; the Your project table and DcpSnapshotCard printed condition raw; the paid report appended it raw
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Render time only, every page view and every paid report from deploy

functions.name: publicCondition
functions.input: the stored condition text of one DCP control row
functions.output: the condition without our internal tags or notes, or null when nothing is left
functions.if_none: returns null so no condition line is shown

functions.name: noNumberLabel
functions.input: a control row's plain_summary field from the structured-controls API
functions.output: the plain summary, or a pointer to the plan's quoted words
functions.if_none: returns the text pointing the reader at the quote

values.read_at: DcpStructuredControls condition column, project-summary dcpEntry, DcpSnapshotCard, brief_templates control sentence
values.guard_at: publicCondition / _INTERNAL_PREFIX_RE, both return empty when only a tag

break_it.scenario: A council's own capitalised heading such as 'NOTE:' starts the condition
break_it.what_happens: Kept: the six tags are listed exactly, not pattern-matched

break_it.scenario: A condition that is only a tag ('NO FIGURE:')
break_it.what_happens: Nothing shown instead of an empty bracket or a bare tag

break_it.scenario: Row whose words hold figures (Ku-ring-gai 9 m / 12 m) but no stored number
break_it.what_happens: Before: 'No set number' contradicted the words. Now: points at the plan's words, and the condition shows the figures

falsifiable_check.fails_when: INTERNAL_PREFIX removed: the 6 tag cases fail; old fallback restored: 3 noNumberLabel assertions fail
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Tag tests written against the unchanged publicCondition would return the raw tag; asserted values differ

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - load the 10 pilot houses (audit address files in the plans folder) and confirm 0 internal tags and 0 bare No set number shown
